cells.quote: "Fig. 9(b) shows that its greedy training-day rollout has a complete cost of $180.19, compared with $191.58 without storage and $216.34 for the straightforward cycle rule. The 5.9% reduction relative to the no-storage case is obtained while returning the 60-kWh battery to its initial empty state."
cells.note: The supplied study text describes the DRL BESS module but does not include the reported Fig. 9 result; quote reproduced from the wiki entry.
